e=df['eps'].values;t=df['T'].values;s=df['sigma'].values
models={
 'C_exp_e': (lambda p,e,T: p[0]*T**p[1]*e**(p[2]+p[3]*T)*np.exp(p[4]*e)+p[5]*T**p[6], 7),
 'D_off_expe': (lambda p,e,T: p[0]*T**p[1]+p[2]*T**p[3]*e**(p[4]+p[5]*T)*np.exp(p[6]*e), 7),
 'E_mult': (lambda p,e,T: (p[0]*T**p[1]+p[2]*e**(p[3]+p[4]*T))*T**p[5], 6),
 'F_offexp': (lambda p,e,T: p[0]*np.exp(p[1]*T)+p[2]*np.exp(p[3]*T)*e**(p[4]+p[5]*T), 6),
 'G_sum3': (lambda p,e,T: p[0]*T**p[1]+p[2]*T**p[3]*e**(p[4]+p[5]*T)+p[6]*T**p[7]*e**(p[8]+p[9]*T), 10),
}
for k,(f,n) in models.items():
    best=None
    for trial in range(30):
        rs=np.random.RandomState(trial)
        p0=rs.uniform(-1,2,n); p0[1]=3
        try:
            r=least_squares(lambda p: np.nan_to_num(f(p,e,t)-s,nan=1e6,posinf=1e6,neginf=-1e6), p0, max_nfev=2000)
            if best is None or r.cost<best.cost: best=r
        except Exception as ex: pass
    if best is not None: print(k, float(np.mean(best.fun**2)/np.var(s)), np.round(best.x,4))
